shared_prior.candidate_stage: Lexical Top20 + Semantic Top20 -> union -> chunk-ID dedup (unchanged)
shared_prior.rewrite: not applied in the frozen single-turn replay (rewrite_calls = 0)

cache_key_schema.stage1_generation_key: stable_hash({validation_version, case_id, evidence_hash, prompt_config_hash, generator_model, context_policy_id, context_policy_hash})
cache_key_schema.reuse_rule: A Stage 1 arm may reuse an existing frozen answer only when selected chunk IDs and order equal the frozen A0-BGE top5 evidence for that case; otherwise it must use the stage1 key.

stage1_comparison.A1_ALWAYS_ADAPTIVE: must beat A0 on quality-cost Pareto, otherwise delete
stage1_comparison.A1_NO_ROUTER_ADAPTIVE: must not be dominated by A1_ROUTER; if it ties, delete router
stage1_comparison.A1_ROUTER: must beat no-router adaptive on quality-cost Pareto, otherwise delete router

arms.algorithm: take BGE-ranked Top5 as the generation context

contiguous prefix from k=5; expands to 8 or deeper on broad-query cues (_BREADTH) or conditional cues (_CONDITION) plus weak query-term coverage; stops on coverage saturation, score plateau/decay, token cap 6000, Top20

greedy set selection over Top20 pool: relevance floor for first min_k=5, then utility = 0.4*relevance + 0.4*semantic_novelty + 0.2*query_term_gain; stops at max_k=12, token cap 6000, or marginal utility < 0.28
prefix from initial_k=5; extend while k < max_k and (bge_score[0] - bge_score[k]) <= max_score_drop and used_tokens + tokens[k] <= max_evidence_tokens; no query text, no query class
route rewritten query with query-structure-router-v1; SIMPLE -> fixed_top5; BROAD -> adaptive_prefix_v1 (existing config)

stage2_shared_rerank_rule.applies_to: Stage 2 (A2) only; frozen now to remove the shared-rerank ambiguity
stage2_shared_rerank_rule.candidate_pool: union by chunk_id of the original-query retrieval and the per-requirement retrievals (each lexical Top20 + semantic Top20)
stage2_shared_rerank_rule.per_query_rerank: BGE-score each (query, build_reranker_text(chunk)) pair independently per query; within-query order by (-score, chunk_id)
stage2_shared_rerank_rule.merge_rule: for each chunk, best_rank = min over queries of its within-query rank; order the merged pool by (best_rank asc, first-query-index asc, chunk_id asc); original query = query index 0, then R1..R3
stage2_shared_rerank_rule.cross_query_scores_prohibited: raw BGE scores from different queries must never be compared, averaged, or fused

mechanism_vs_adoption.mechanism_proof: existence proof only, evaluated on cases selected by the observed failure type
mechanism_vs_adoption.architecture_adoption: must be evaluated on a pre-frozen, unfiltered query set (default: Validation V1 50) reporting trigger frequency, net quality, and total cost
mechanism_vs_adoption.no_post_filtering: adoption may not be argued from failure-type-selected subsets
